summary: GATE-EX4 closes as pass_with_conditions for routing and design authority only. It authorizes a later bounded tooling/design sprint for operation and answer-skill storage contracts, validators, q19 extraction contract/validator, rollback, and audit evidence, while preserving all protected mutation, lesson-output, closure, and student/product-use blocks.

explicit_decisions.decision: Close GATE-EX4 as pass_with_conditions - routing/design only.
Keep q3-calc-1 as an operation-registry design candidate; A61 is support only and A15 remains stale or incorrect for this task.
Keep q3-answer-1 as a separate answer-skill candidate until an answer-skill registry or governed equivalent exists.
q19 source-annex and graph-object extraction must be resolved or explicitly carried as blocking before graph/PV, reasoning, lesson handoff, PV projection, or student-facing use.
Hold graph/PV execution; carry A42 and D10 as candidates and A45 as weak support only.
Keep q19-reason-1 as a provisional operation-registry candidate blocked by q19 source/graph gaps, with D10 and D13 as partial support.
Keep q15-answer-1 as an answer-skill candidate; D27, F03, and F09 cover content only.
Design operation and answer-skill storage contracts, schemas, validators, rollback, and audit evidence before any registry mutation.
Authorize a bounded tooling/design sprint only, with no mutation execution.

No protected mutation, external-source mutation, machine-reference mutation, unit minting, operation-registry mutation, answer-skill mutation, PV/graph mutation, target-exercise promotion, lesson-output mutation, CP-6 closure, Year-1 closure, diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.

accepted_outcomes: GATE-EX4 may close as a routing and design gate.

A later bounded tooling/design sprint may define operation-registry storage contract, answer-skill storage contract, validators, q19 extraction contract and validator, rollback, audit evidence, and stop conditions.
q3-calc-1 may enter later operation-registry design as an annual cost-threshold comparison candidate.
q3-answer-1 remains a separate answer-skill candidate.
q19 source-annex and graph-object extraction is the prerequisite lane before graph/PV, reasoning, lesson handoff, PV projection, or student-facing use.
q19-graph-op-1 carries A42 and D10 as candidates, with A45 weak support only.
q19-reason-1 remains a provisional operation-registry candidate blocked by q19 source/graph gaps.
q15-answer-1 remains a separate answer-skill candidate; D27, F03, and F09 cover content only.
blocked_outcomes: No protected reference mutation is authorized.
No student diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery decisions, automatic sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.
conditions_to_reopen_or_pass: No mutation from EX-4 or GATE-EX4.

q19 graph/PV and reasoning remain blocked while q19 source/graph gaps remain unresolved.
q3 and q15 answer-skill gaps must remain visible downstream.

q19 source-annex/graph-object extraction contract and validator
